basic_details.job_title: FCI Dhar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 10 Assistant, Lab Attendant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Food Craft Institute (FCI), Dhar is a new institute under the Department of Tourism, Government of Madhya Pradesh, and is affiliated to NCHMCT, Noida. It needs 10 staff to run its diploma and craft courses. The jobs are filled through an outsourcing agency, Agile Security Force Private Limited, Hyderabad, which is a private company. The posts are:

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from www.sihmind.mp.gov.in. The notice has two forms: "Application form for Teaching Associate" and "Application form for Non-Teaching Staffs".

Fill in the form. It asks for personal details, category (PH/SC/ST/OBC/GEN), educational qualifications in ascending order with the percentage of marks, and experience in chronological order. The Teaching Associate form also asks for teaching experience, industry experience (hotel and star category) and an optional NHTET score.
Paste a recent passport-size colour photograph on the form, signed across, and sign the declaration.

Send the hard copy by Speed Post, or email a scanned copy to [email protected]. The first page of the notice, signed by the In-charge Principal of FCI Dhar, asks for the resume with documents at [email protected] or at the institute's address: Gram Jetpura, Tehsil Dhar, Dis. Dhar (M.P.) 462101.
Send the application on or before 30 November 2026. The agency is not responsible for postal delays.
If you already work in a government or autonomous body, apply through proper channel. A direct application from such a candidate will be rejected.
Self-attested copies of certificates (attested copies of all educational testimonials)
Copies of experience documents (teaching, industry or work experience)
No Objection Certificate (NOC). The form says this is for candidates already employed on a regular or temporary basis, on the letterhead of the head of the organisation.
important_instructions: An incomplete application, without the required documents or certificates, will be rejected. The application form says that a form without the NOC or the self-certified supporting documents is liable to be treated as invalid. If any information in the application is found false at any stage, the candidature or selection is liable to be rejected or cancelled. The competent authority may fill, partly fill or not fill the posts, cancel them, or re-advertise them. Contact numbers printed by FCI Dhar: 9406800131, 9039503035.

Teaching Associate, Assistant Grade-2 (Accountant), Assistant Grade-3 (Store Keeper/Clerk), Hostel Warden (Female/Male), Lab Attendant, Maintenance/Foreman/Electrician
Rs. 25,000 per month (consolidated) to Collector rate, District Dhar (approx. Rs. 14,000 to 16,000), varies by post
Food Craft Institute, Dhar, Madhya Pradesh

content_sections.heading: About FCI Dhar
content_sections.text: The letterhead describes Food Craft Institute, Dhar as an institute of the Department of Tourism, Government of Madhya Pradesh, affiliated to NCHMCT, Noida. It is located at Gram Jetpura, Tehsil Dhar, Dis. Dhar (M.P.) 462101. The staff are needed to run its diploma and craft courses. The detailed notice and the application forms are issued by the HR Manager of Agile Security Force Private Limited. The agency's address is 3rd Floor, Uma Enclave, Road No 09, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad-500034.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice gives post-wise numbers that add up to 10 posts. No category-wise break-up is printed. FCI Dhar also needs a cook, cleaning staff, a gardener and security staff. The notice does not give the number or the pay for these jobs. For more information, it directs applicants to www.sihmind.mp.gov.in or to the office of the State Institute of Hotel Management, Indore, Tarik Khan ki Tekri, DPS / near Silicon Valley, Indore Bypass Road, Rau, Indore (M.P.) 453331.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own qualification and experience, as printed below. The notice does not specify an age limit for any post. Candidates must meet any one of these three routes: Route 1: Both degrees below, with at least 60% aggregate marks in either the bachelor's or the master's degree: a full-time bachelor's degree in Hospitality and Hotel Administration / Hotel Management after 10+2, from a recognised university; and a full-time master's degree in Hospitality and Hotel Administration / Hotel Management / Tourism Management. OR Route 2: A full-time bachelor's degree in Hospitality and Hotel Administration / Hotel Management after 10+2, from a recognised university, with at least 60% aggregate marks, plus at least 2 years of industry experience. OR Route 3: NHTET qualified (conducted by NCHMCT) with the percentage prescribed for qualifying as Teaching Associate. Candidates with a Ph.D. in Hospitality / Hotel Management need not pass the prescribed NHTET. Graduate degree in Commerce with 55% marks from a recognised university. Knowledge of Tally and computer literacy are mandatory. Experience: at least 2 years in administrative matters in the accounts branch of any government office. Graduate in any subject, with knowledge of store (inventory) software. Experience: 2 years of office experience. Graduate in any subject. Experience: 2 years of hostel warden work. One post is for a woman and one for a man. 12th pass. Preference goes to certificate/diploma holders in Food Production, Bakery or F&B Service with 2 years of experience. 12th pass, or 10th pass with ITI in the Electrician trade, with 2 years of experience. For the full eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Teaching Associate: Rs. 25,000 per month, consolidated. Accountant: salary of Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 20,000, which the notice marks as negotiable. Store Keeper/Clerk and Hostel Warden: Collector rate (skilled) for District Dhar, approximately Rs. 16,000. Lab Attendant and Maintenance/Foreman/Electrician: Collector rate for District Dhar, approximately Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 16,000. All engagements are through the outsourcing agency. The notice calls the Teaching Associate post full time. The length of the engagement is not specified in the notice.

It asks for personal details, category (PH/SC/ST/OBC/GEN), educational qualifications in ascending order with the percentage of marks, and experience in chronological order. The Teaching Associate form also asks for teaching experience, industry experience (hotel and star category) and an optional NHTET score. Paste a recent passport-size colour photograph on the form, signed across, and sign the declaration. Attach the documents listed below. Send the hard copy by Speed Post, or email a scanned copy to [email protected] . The first page of the notice, signed by the In-charge Principal of FCI Dhar, asks for the resume with documents at [email protected] or at the institute's address: Gram Jetpura, Tehsil Dhar, Dis. Dhar (M.P.) 462101. Send the application on or before 30 November 2026. The agency is not responsible for postal delays. If you already work in a government or autonomous body, apply through proper channel. A direct application from such a candidate will be rejected. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice mentions an interview, a teaching ability test and a subject skill test. It says that candidates coming for these will not be paid any TA/DA (travel or daily allowance). The notice does not give the date or venue of these stages. It also does not say which test applies to which post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in FCI Dhar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 posts: Teaching Associate 2, Accountant 1, Store Keeper/Clerk 2, Hostel Warden 2 (one female, one male), Lab Attendant 2 and Maintenance/Foreman/Electrician 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for FCI Dhar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the FCI Dhar Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: There are three alternative routes: a full-time bachelor's and master's degree in Hospitality and Hotel Administration / Hotel Management (or Tourism Management for the master's), with 60% in either degree; or the bachelor's degree with 60% and 2 years of industry experience; or NHTET qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Lab Attendant post at FCI Dhar?
faq.answer: 12th pass. Preference goes to certificate/diploma holders in Food Production, Bakery or F&B Service with 2 years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for FCI Dhar posts?
faq.answer: Teaching Associate gets Rs. 25,000 per month consolidated, and Accountant gets Rs. 18,000 to 20,000 (negotiable). The other posts get the Collector rate for District Dhar, approximately Rs. 14,000 to 16,000.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for FCI Dhar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from www.sihmind.mp.gov.in and attach the documents. Send it by Speed Post or by email to [email protected]. Page 1 of the notice also gives [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The notice mentions an interview, a teaching ability test and a subject skill test. No TA/DA is paid for attending them.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a direct government job at FCI Dhar?
faq.answer: No. The posts are filled through an outsourcing agency, Agile Security Force Private Limited, Hyderabad, which is a private company.

faq.question: Q9. Can employed candidates apply directly?
faq.answer: No. Candidates already working in a government or autonomous body must apply through proper channel with an NOC. Their direct applications will be rejected.
